'''Pilot''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who died in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]].

==Biography==
Pilot was a member of a group of bounty hunters assembled by [[Magus (bounty hunter)|Magus]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] twenty galactic leaders at a conference on [[Rondai-2]]. When a young [[Gender/Legends|boy]], [[Talesan Fry]], discovered their plans, a bounty was placed on his head. He was captured for them by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Magnus and the other bounty hunters took Talesan to the conference, where they were confronted on a roof top by [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]]. Pilot held Talesan over the roof while Magus threatned to drop him if the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] didn't let Magus and Pilot escape. However when Qui-gon agreed, Magus flew away without waiting for Pilot, who was balancing on the top of the [[Cruiser/Legends|small cruiser]]. Pilot fell to his death with a muffled scream, however, Siri managed to prevent Talesan from falling as well.
